d:
Kamala Harris launches a blistering attack on President Donald Trump and his administration during a campaign rally in Georgia alongside Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff, days before the November 3 US midterm elections.
Harris describes the Trump administration as “the most callous, corrupt, and incompetent” in American history, accusing Republicans of hypocrisy over family values while criticising cuts to Medicaid and SNAP benefits. She also targets the administration over rising living costs, tariffs, the war with Iran and allegations of corruption.
